purpose: Voila is a personal development operating system built on the Pi coding-agent harness; it preserves planning sources, holds durable project truth, requires evidence before completion, and proposes a delivery boundary a human approves. This session is a high-rigor attempt to drive NF-1..NF-4 through the protected completion transition with refreshed evidence.
